networking.title: Computer Networking
networking.description: Understand how data moves between devices, from local networks to internet-scale services.
networking.audience: For developers and infrastructure engineers who want a practical foundation in network protocols and troubleshooting.
networking.goal: Trace, diagnose, and design reliable network communication for an application.

levels.goal: Learn the basic building blocks and protocols of network communication.

skills.name: Network Models & Core Concepts
skills.description: Build a mental model of how local and internet networks deliver data.
outcomes: Explain the roles of the link, internet, transport, and application layers
Distinguish switches, routers, clients, and servers
Trace how a packet travels across networks

resources.label: Cloudflare Learning: What is a computer network?
Cloudflare Learning: What is the OSI model?

skills.name: IP Addressing, Subnets & DNS
skills.description: Learn how devices are addressed and how human-readable names locate services.
outcomes: Read IPv4 and IPv6 addresses
Explain subnets, gateways, and basic routing
Trace a DNS lookup

resources.label: Cloudflare Learning: What is an IP address?

project.title: Trace a web request
project.description: Document the DNS lookup, addressing, and network-layer steps involved in reaching a website.

levels.goal: Understand transport and application protocols and diagnose real connections.

skills.name: TCP, UDP & Ports
skills.description: Compare transport protocols and learn how applications communicate through ports.
outcomes: Explain TCP connections, acknowledgements, and retransmission
Choose between TCP and UDP for common use cases
Inspect listening and connected sockets

skills.name: HTTP, TLS & Web Communication
skills.description: Follow a secure web connection from request to response.
outcomes: Read HTTP methods, headers, and status codes
Explain how TLS protects a connection
Use command-line tools to inspect HTTP requests

resources.label: curl: The Art Of HTTP Scripting

skills.name: Network Troubleshooting & Packet Analysis
skills.description: Use diagnostic commands and packet captures to find connection problems.
outcomes: Use ping, traceroute, and DNS lookup tools appropriately
Capture and filter traffic in Wireshark
Distinguish name-resolution, routing, and transport failures

project.title: Diagnose a connection
project.description: Use DNS and packet-analysis tools to diagnose a failing HTTP connection and explain the root cause.

levels.goal: Design networks and services for scale, resilience, and secure operation.

skills.name: Routing, Proxies & Load Balancing
skills.description: Explore how traffic is routed and distributed across larger systems.
outcomes: Explain routing and autonomous systems at a high level
Compare forward proxies, reverse proxies, and load balancers
Select health checks and traffic-distribution strategies

skills.name: Network Reliability & Security
skills.description: Apply practical security and resilience principles to networked applications.
outcomes: Identify common network attack surfaces
Apply segmentation and least-privilege access concepts
Design timeouts, retries, and connection limits that fail safely

resources.label: OWASP: Transport Layer Security Cheat Sheet
NIST SP 800-41 Rev. 1: Guidelines on Firewalls and Firewall Policy
Google SRE Book: Addressing Cascading Failures

project.title: Resilient service network
project.description: Design a secure service topology with routing, load balancing, health checks, and failure-handling policies.

capstone.title: Networked service field guide
capstone.description: Deliver a network diagram, request trace, troubleshooting notes, and reliability and security recommendations for a small service.

testing.title: Testing & Quality Engineering
testing.description: Build confidence in software through thoughtful test design, automation, and quality practices.
testing.audience: For software developers and quality engineers who want to prevent regressions and ship dependable changes.
testing.goal: Create a maintainable automated test strategy that gives useful feedback throughout development.

levels.goal: Learn what to test and how to write focused, useful checks.

skills.name: Test Design & Quality Fundamentals
skills.description: Turn requirements and risks into clear, repeatable test cases.
outcomes: Distinguish expected behavior from implementation details
Choose representative boundary and equivalence cases
Report failures with reproducible steps

resources.label: YouTube videos: software testing fundamentals and test design techniques

skills.name: Unit Testing & Test Doubles
skills.description: Test small units of behavior in isolation while keeping tests readable and stable.
outcomes: Write tests for normal, boundary, and error cases
Use stubs and fakes to isolate dependencies
Recognize brittle tests and avoid over-mocking

resources.label: YouTube videos: pytest unit testing and test doubles

project.title: Test a small utility
project.description: Write a focused suite covering normal, boundary, and failure behavior for a small library or utility.

levels.goal: Test interactions across application boundaries and automate quality feedback.

skills.name: Integration & API Testing
skills.description: Verify that modules, services, and APIs work together as expected.
outcomes: Test API contracts and error responses
Manage test data and isolated environments
Choose boundaries for integration tests

resources.label: Postman Learning Center: Writing test scripts
YouTube videos: automated API testing with Postman

skills.name: End-to-End & Browser Automation
skills.description: Exercise important user journeys through a running application.
outcomes: Automate critical user journeys
Use selectors and waits that reduce flakiness
Capture useful artifacts when a test fails

resources.label: YouTube videos: Playwright end-to-end testing tutorials

skills.name: Test Automation & CI Quality Gates
skills.description: Run a fast, dependable test suite automatically as code changes.
outcomes: Organize fast checks and slower suites into stages
Run tests in continuous integration
Use coverage and static checks as signals rather than goals

resources.label: GitHub Actions: Building and testing your code
YouTube videos: GitHub Actions CI testing workflow tutorial

project.title: Automated application checks
project.description: Build a CI workflow that runs unit, API integration, and one critical end-to-end test.

levels.goal: Evaluate system qualities beyond basic functional correctness.

skills.name: Performance & Load Testing
skills.description: Measure response under load and identify meaningful bottlenecks.
outcomes: Define realistic workload models
Measure latency percentiles and throughput
Use results to guide targeted optimization

resources.label: YouTube videos: Grafana k6 load testing tutorials

skills.name: Reliability & Security Testing
skills.description: Test recovery behavior and look for security weaknesses within an authorized development scope.
outcomes: Test timeout and recovery behavior
Include dependency and input-validation checks
Prioritize findings by likelihood and impact

resources.label: Google SRE Workbook: Testing for Reliability
YouTube videos: application security testing and reliability testing

project.title: Quality and resilience report
project.description: Extend an automated test pipeline with a representative load test and documented recovery and security checks.

capstone.title: A maintainable quality strategy
capstone.description: Deliver a layered test suite, CI workflow, representative performance results, and a concise quality risk report.

compilers.title: Compilers & Language Tools
compilers.description: Explore how programming languages are parsed, checked, interpreted, and compiled into executable forms.
compilers.audience: For programmers curious about language implementation, developer tools, and how source code becomes a running program.
compilers.goal: Implement a small language and explain the major stages of its implementation.

levels.goal: Build the front end of a small programming language.

skills.name: Language Processing & Grammars
skills.description: Understand tokens, grammars, and the structure of a language implementation.
outcomes: Describe the compiler and interpreter pipeline
Write a small grammar for expressions
Explain the roles of lexing, parsing, and semantic analysis

skills.name: Lexing, Parsing & Syntax Trees
skills.description: Turn source text into a structured representation that software can analyze.
outcomes: Tokenize source text
Parse expressions with precedence
Represent programs with an abstract syntax tree

project.title: Expression parser
project.description: Implement a lexer and parser that turns arithmetic expressions into an abstract syntax tree.

levels.goal: Give the language behavior and check programs before execution.

skills.name: Interpreters & Runtime Semantics
skills.description: Execute a language by evaluating its syntax tree and managing program state.
outcomes: Evaluate expressions and statements
Represent environments and variable scope
Define clear runtime errors

skills.name: Type Checking & Static Analysis
skills.description: Catch invalid programs and produce useful diagnostics before execution.
outcomes: Design a small type system
Report type errors with source locations
Perform a basic static analysis over an AST

resources.label: Crafting Interpreters: A Bytecode Virtual Machine - Types of Values

project.title: Typed mini-language
project.description: Extend the expression language with variables and functions, an interpreter, and source-aware type errors.

levels.goal: Lower programs into a machine-oriented representation and improve generated code.

skills.name: Intermediate Representations & Code Generation
skills.description: Translate a language into an intermediate form and generate executable output.
outcomes: Explain why compilers use intermediate representations
Lower syntax into a control-flow representation
Generate code for a target or virtual machine

skills.name: Optimization & Compiler Tooling
skills.description: Apply semantics-preserving optimizations and make language tools easier to use.
outcomes: Implement constant folding or dead-code elimination
Explain optimization correctness and tradeoffs
Add source maps, diagnostics, or a basic language-server feature

project.title: Compile a small language
project.description: Compile the typed mini-language to bytecode or native code and document one verified optimization.

capstone.title: A small programming language
capstone.description: Deliver a documented language with parsing, diagnostics, execution or code generation, tests, and an example program.

graphics.title: Computer Graphics & Rendering
graphics.description: Learn the mathematics and techniques used to turn geometric scenes into images.
graphics.audience: For programmers interested in rendering, visualization, games, simulation, and GPU programming.
graphics.goal: Build a small real-time renderer and explain its core graphics pipeline.

levels.goal: Build the mathematical and rendering foundations for drawing 2D and 3D scenes.

skills.name: Graphics Math & Coordinate Spaces
skills.description: Use vectors and matrices to describe geometry and transform objects between spaces.
outcomes: Perform vector operations used in rendering
Apply model, view, and projection transformations
Explain coordinate spaces and homogeneous coordinates

skills.name: Rasterization & the Rendering Pipeline
skills.description: Understand how geometry is transformed, clipped, and converted into pixels.
outcomes: Describe the major stages of a rasterization pipeline
Explain vertices, triangles, and fragments
Render a basic 2D or 3D scene

project.title: Transform and draw a scene
project.description: Render a simple scene with a camera and interactive transformations.

levels.goal: Control the rendering pipeline with shaders, lighting, and materials.

skills.name: Shaders & GPU Programming
skills.description: Write small programs that run on the GPU to transform vertices and shade pixels.
outcomes: Write and debug vertex and fragment shaders
Pass attributes and uniforms through a pipeline
Explain GPU buffers and draw calls

skills.name: Lighting, Materials & Textures
skills.description: Represent surface appearance and illuminate objects in a scene.
outcomes: Implement basic diffuse and specular lighting
Apply textures and material parameters
Explain color spaces and normal vectors in shading

project.title: Shaded 3D scene
project.description: Build a small scene with camera controls, textured objects, and a moveable light source.

levels.goal: Explore physically based rendering and make performance-informed design choices.

skills.name: Physically Based Rendering
skills.description: Use energy-conscious shading models to create consistent materials under varied lighting.
outcomes: Explain the roles of albedo, roughness, and metallic parameters
Use a microfacet BRDF at a conceptual level
Apply environment lighting to a scene

skills.name: Rendering Performance & GPU Profiling
skills.description: Measure rendering bottlenecks and improve frame-time consistency.
outcomes: Distinguish CPU-bound and GPU-bound work
Use a graphics profiler or frame capture
Reduce unnecessary work through batching and level-of-detail choices

project.title: Optimized real-time renderer
project.description: Add physically based materials to a scene, profile its rendering, and document a measurable optimization.

capstone.title: A real-time graphics demo
capstone.description: Deliver a documented interactive scene with shaders, lighting, materials, performance measurements, and a short rendering walkthrough.
